answer: Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, reset on any identity-link attempt, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. The quartz is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the ripple. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the nebula of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
